verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so asking about checkout payment-method coverage is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the pack mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL, or any payment-method configuration. The docs cover only metering, plan attach, the customer portal and Stripe catalog reuse, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
